description: Summarise a Steam library's backlog: total games, how many were never played, total playtime, the most-played game, a playtime distribution, and highly rated games the player owns but has never opened. Use for 'how big is my backlog' or 'what should I play from my library'.

profile.description: A Steam profile URL (steamcommunity.com/id/name or /profiles/7656...), a custom URL name, or a SteamID64. The profile's Game details must be public.

name: steam_backlog
title: Steam backlog summary
